name: Seibu Giken Co.,Ltd.
summary: Seibu Giken Co., Ltd. was established in 1962 and is headquartered in Koga, Japan. It designs and supplies equipment for environmental protection and energy efficiency, such as commercial desiccant dehumidifiers, dry rooms, low dew point glove boxes, VOC concentrators, heat wheel systems, honeycomb filters and NMP recovery solutions. It took its present name in July 1995.
